title: Contact Us | Lalitpur Financial Advisory Nepal
metaDescription: Get in touch with Lalitpur Financial Advisory. Book a consultation, visit our Lalitpur office in Pulchowk-Kumaripati, or connect via phone and WhatsApp.
h1: Contact Our Advisory Desk in Lalitpur
directAnswer: Contact Lalitpur Financial Advisory for commercial consultations, business registration assistance, and personal wealth reviews. We offer in-person consultations at our Lalitpur commercial office as well as secure online video advisory for clients across all seven provinces of Nepal.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Client Relations

sections.contentHtml:
Lalitpur Practice Headquarters

Consultation Hours & Reach

Sunday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Nepal Time, NPT)

Saturday: Closed (Emergency client desk by appointment)

In-Person Service: Lalitpur, Kathmandu, and Bhaktapur Valley.

Nationwide Digital Desk: Video discovery sessions across all 7 Provinces (Koshi, Madhesh, Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali, Sudurpashchim).
Submit your details below to schedule an advisory consultation with our senior corporate finance or personal wealth team. We guarantee confidential review within 1 business day.

faqs.question: How quickly will an advisor respond to my contact enquiry?
faqs.answer: Our Lalitpur client desk acknowledges all inbound enquiries within 4 business hours and coordinates your discovery session within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Can we conduct our initial consultation via Google Meet or Zoom?
faqs.answer: Yes. Over 60% of our corporate engagements begin via secure video meetings, supporting entrepreneurs from Pokhara, Biratnagar, Butwal, and international investors.

cta.headline: Submit Your Consultation Enquiry
cta.subtext: Complete our validated enquiry form to schedule your 45-minute discovery session.
